_about: Captioned store images (test/store_frame_render_test.dart, store/frames.py). Slides in product-page order: a scene from lib/src/screenshots.dart, or a real-device image. Captions per App Store locale; {price} is the base unlock's price for that locale, from shot_prices.json. Copy approved by Spencer 11 Oct 2026.
